map.GRACE 缺血事件风险评分 使用指南: GRACE Ischemic Event Risk Score User Guide
map.用于急性冠脉综合征（ACS）患者院内死亡风险预测。依据 GRACE 注册研究，综: Used to predict in-hospital mortality risk for patients with acute coronary syndrome (ACS). Based on the GRACE registry study, it looks up and sums 8 indicators; the higher the score, the higher the risk.
map.GRACE 缺血事件评分：年龄、心率、收缩压、肌酐、Killip、标志物、ST: GRACE ischemic event score: age, heart rate, systolic pressure, creatinine, Killip class, biomarkers, ST deviation and cardiac-arrest history are weighted and summed to predict in-hospital and long-term death or ischemia in ACS.
map.危险分层与侵入时机：高分（多 >140）倾向 24h 内造影 + PCI；极高危: Risk stratification and invasive timing: a high score (many above 140) favors angiography within 24h plus PCI; very-high-risk patients need immediate intervention.
map.预后与随访：分值联动 6 个月事件风险，指导出院后双抗时长、他汀强度与康复。: Prognosis and follow-up: the score links to 6-month event risk and guides post-discharge dual antiplatelet duration, statin intensity and rehabilitation.
map.：输入：男、61 岁、心率 96、收缩压 118、肌酐 100、Killip I: Input: male, 61 years old, heart rate 96, systolic 118, creatinine 100, Killip I, troponin +, ST depression, no arrest. The tool outputs: GRACE about 109 points, stratum intermediate risk, advice early invasive strategy (angiography within 24h), follow-up dual antiplatelet + high-intensity statin. Note: values move with the indicators, so the latest reading governs.

map.GRACE 与 TIMI 怎么选？: How Do I Choose Between GRACE and TIMI?
map.两者均用于 ACS 风险；GRACE 项目更全（含血压/肾/ Killip）、预: Both are used for ACS risk. GRACE covers more items (including blood pressure, kidney and Killip) and predicts death more steadily, so guidelines use it mainly to time invasive strategy; TIMI has fewer items and leans toward ischemic events. They complement each other, so you need not pick only one.
map.侵入策略一定更好吗？: Is an Invasive Strategy Always Better?
map.对高危/极高危 NSTE-ACS 早期造影改善预后；低危且出血风险高者可先保守治: Early angiography improves the prognosis in high-risk and very-high-risk NSTE-ACS; low-risk patients with high bleeding risk can start with conservative treatment plus a loading test. Timing depends on stability, bleeding and team capability, and follows the chest pain center pathway.
map.出院后还要管什么？: What Else Needs Follow-Up After Discharge?
map.双抗（时长因病种）、高强度他汀、β 阻滞/ACEI 等二级预防，结合心脏康复；按: Dual antiplatelet therapy (duration depends on the condition), high-intensity statin, beta blocker or ACEI and other secondary prevention, combined with cardiac rehabilitation; tailor follow-up density to the GRACE risk and control risk factors to reduce recurrence.
